tasks.label: start-redis-debug
tasks.command: docker start vsuet_rating_v2-redis-DEBUG 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name vsuet_rating_v2-redis-DEBUG -p 6379:6379 -v vsuet_rating_v2-redis-DEBUG-data:/data redis:7-alpine redis-server --save 60 1 --dbfilename dump.rdb --dir /data

tasks.label: clear-redis-debug
tasks.command: docker exec vsuet_rating_v2-redis-DEBUG sh -c "until redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG; do sleep 0.1; done && redis-cli flushall"
